reviews.review:
I feel this game can be best described by the now famous Chernobyl TV show line "not great, not terrible"
It's pretty much urban Far Cry with vampires and some shoehorned powers for the main characters. The AI is kinda terrible, and will rotate between being absolutely ruthless killers and being completely braindead, and the graphics are serviceable, but it's a fun time in co-op so far and they've fixed the performance issues I encountered when I first tried the game on gamepass.
Is it a good Arkane game? Hell no! Is it a fun cooperative timewaster? I think so.
Great on Steam Deck, shame there's no offline mode.
At 75%, its an okay game. Not good but not bad either. Just an okay game.

It's all right - although on a 2060 I had to drop those graphics settings to lose the frame rate freeze. On a 4060 with 32GB of RAM it's as smooth as butter. Offing a vampire with a shotgun to the face followed up by  a stake to the heart can make you feel like a regular little Buffy. Poking around the town of Redfall is good fun although despite it being populated by the undead it can feel a little lifeless (!). 

The tone is mixed, and this can break the immersion. Your out of place character quips grate - and the AI for the cultist/soldier enemies is so shaky its like shooting fish in a barrel. If the devs had sharpened up the ai more and leaned into the horror this could have been something special.

It's ok solo, probably more fun with others - assuming of course you can convince anyone else to play it.

This is not Arkanes' best work (actually it's at the bottom of pile). Get it on sale, ignore the 'bite back' upgrade, and pretend Arkane didn't make it - then it doesn't feel quite as bad. Personally I like the scenario of wandering through an open world reclaiming it from an army of bloodthirsty vampires. And I have a fondness for below average games. This is definitely that - and I still find it a lot of fun. 

Somehow (so far as of October 25) this is still working on my rig. I'm set to off-line play which may be mitigating the problems. If you get an UE4 error, check your drivers, verify your game files and quit forcing DX11.

I LOVE this game, I was super excited about it since the first ever teaser trailer came out and I'm not disappointed at all. I don't understand the negativity... It can be buggy at times, but so can all games and we're getting regular updates. I am very happy with this game and am looking forward to future dlc's+ large updates :)

FYI - I'm sad it got shut down, but the last major update was really good, so it's very nice to play, less buggy and more satisfactory.

In a nutshell: as a game this game really sucks.

It has severe balancing issues. They never should have mixed group playing with solo playing. Either the game is too easy to groups or too hard for solo players.

If you are a solo player the game is practically unplayable. Example: I left the firehouse and turned right. A short distance from the firehouse I ended up fighting about 5 vampires as a level 2 character with appropriate weapons for my level. I only lasted a short time. A group probably could have handled them but a low-level solo player it was impossible. 

You must complete a quest or you have to redo it. I really hate games which do not allow me to save on the fly but this is the worst. It is basically complete or redo no in-between.

I cannot recommend this game to anyone.
